statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 4 ≤ n → Even n → (n:ℝ) < Real.exp (Real.exp 5) → ∃ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ 2 ≤ n-p ∧ (n-p).primeFactorsList.length ≤ 47 ∧ ((n:ℝ) < Real.exp (Real.exp (19/5)) → (n-p).primeFactorsList.length ≤ 14)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 小偶数覆盖续批 · FR-8005 · 把两个原型区间的因子数上界降到 14 和 47
plain_statement.en: New route · Finite-range coverage II · FR-8005 · Improve the two prototype factor bounds to 14 and 47

brief.zh: 用 23^Ω≤n−p 并验证 exp(3.8)<15 log 23、exp(5)<48 log 23。小于 210235 时 n=4 单列，其余偶数取 p=3 后用奇因子 ≥3。
brief.en: Use 23^Ω≤n−p and verify exp(3.8)<15 log 23 and exp(5)<48 log 23. Below 210235 handle 4 separately and take p=3 for the other evens, whose remainder has only odd factors.
